notes: ἕως οὗ: rule 94's exclusion applies because ἕως spells the whole English *till* by itself, so the relative stands unrepresented. Joining the two tokens into one aligned unit on *till*, as rule 50 does for ἕως ἄν, remains the competing reading — but rule 50's reasoning turns on ἄν, which the corpus never leaves empty.
